row.problem_statement: Fix the query compiler so model fields are validated before SQL is generated.
row.patch:
diff --git a/django/db/models.py b/django/db/models.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/django/db/models.py
+++ b/django/db/models.py
@@ -10,3 +10,4 @@ class Model:
     def save(self):
-        return None
+        return self._save_table()
diff --git a/django/db/query.py b/django/db/query.py
index 3333333..4444444 100644
--- a/django/db/query.py
+++ b/django/db/query.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
-def compile():
+def compile_query():
     return None
diff --git a/django/db/models.py b/django/db/models.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/django/db/models.py
+++ b/django/db/models.py
@@ -20,2 +20,2 @@
-old = 1
+old = 2
